highlights: Browser-controlled telepresence base accepting a separately supplied tablet
Tilting tablet head and front/rear camera switching support remote visits
Automatic docking depends on tablet orientation and compatibility; manufacturer flags iPad limitations

Current web specifications list 13.4 kg and 142.5 cm height with tablet, whereas the survey PDF with 2019 metadata lists 10 kg and 125 cm under the same Pad name. Hardware revision mapping remains unresolved; shipping weight and dock dimensions are not substituted.

The technical table separately rates 10 h operation and 10 h full charging. Homepage10+hour wording has unspecified conditions; USB tablet power and173 Wh battery energy do not establish another endurance value.

Autodocking requires a horizontal tablet and orientation sensor; the manufacturer flags possible iPad docking failure and microphone loss after camera switching. Recording and screen-sharing functions also have OS/client limits rather than universal support.

Head travel is described as 160 degrees up plus 180 down in the feature list, 160 degrees in the table, and 120 degrees in the older survey. Those scopes remain unresolved, not an exact joint count or guaranteed universal head sweep; browser/watchdog/encryption labels are not independent security or safety certification.

companyFocus.name: BotEyes
companyFocus.role: Browser-driven telepresence bases with tablet or documented surveillance-camera head configurations
highlights: Pad is a tablet-head telepresence base with a separate motion-control computer. Pad+ and Pad++ are tablet bundles; the support index separately names Mini with a surveillance-camera workflow.

Browser motion control is distinct from video/camera communication. Mini uses CamHi/HiP2P plus a browser; Pad documentation qualifies recording, screen sharing, camera switching and autodocking by device, OS and orientation.

The contact page presents US and Georgia company contacts without independently proving corporate registration. Historical price/body differences, old OS/software names, absolute stability/battery-safety language and encryption labels do not establish present stock, universal compatibility, independent safety/security or exclusive superiority.

Native current technical-table cell ownership and page7 survey BotEyes-Pad column verified. Pad+/Pad++ are tablet bundles, while Mini is an explicitly named camera-head configuration with CamHi plus separate browser drive control. No Pad body, tablet, docking or endurance numbers inherited by Mini. Shipping25kg/75x38x35cm and inconsistent dock-dimension units excluded. Head-tilt list/table/survey scopes do not establish joint count or a resolved universal tilt range. Historical software/OS names and security labels do not establish current compatibility, independent security or safety. No login, test drive, remote hardware control, forms, messages, accounts, transactions, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse.
